observation.visible_scene: A black non-stick frying pan with a long dark handle lies flat on a forest floor covered in dry brown leaves, pine needles, and a few green plants. Near the center of the pan sits a dark, roughly spherical object (charred/coconut-shell-like) that is actively burning. A bright orange-yellow flame rises from the top of this object, and the fire's glow is reflected on the pan's inner surface.
visible_changes: The flame on the object flickers continuously, changing shape and height from frame to frame: sometimes a single tall thin tongue, sometimes split into two or three tongues, sometimes leaning to the right, sometimes more upright or shorter.
The orange reflection on the pan's interior shifts in brightness and position in step with the changing flame.
The burning object, the pan, and its handle remain stationary in the same position throughout the segment.
The background of leaves and plants shows no motion, indicating a fixed camera view.
outside_clip_unknowns: The exact identity and material of the burning object.
How or when the fire was started before this segment.
Whether the flame grows, shrinks, or extinguishes after the last frame.
uncertain_details: The object's surface texture is partly obscured by darkness and the flame.
No clear camera movement is evident, but minor framing differences between frames cannot be fully ruled out.
